title: Basic parallel turns
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: Start with your skis parallel and about hip-width apart.
Tip both skis onto their edges together.
Finish each turn before you start the next.

callouts.text: Smaller, rounder humps than carving: lighter edging.
Both boots stay close together through the turn.
Matching left and right humps show an even turn on both sides.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
